svg.title: CAN communication between two ESP32-C3 boards and their CAN modules
svg.desc: Sender on the left, receiver on the right. USB powers both ESPs separately. GPIO 5 connects to CTX; CRX connects to GPIO 4. CANH, CANL and GND connect the modules. Signal highlights are based on serial log messages, not electrical measurements.
svg.text: Schematic pin positions · 3V3 and GND stay static · Separate USB power
